66278-summer-flowers-of-the-high-alps.title: The High Alps
66278-summer-flowers-of-the-high-alps.creator: Somerville Hastings
66278-summer-flowers-of-the-high-alps.description: A book by Somerville Hastings. Many varieties of Anemone are found in Switzerland. Not only have we the common English Wood Anemone (_A. nemorosa_) of the early spring, and the much rarer Pasque Flower (_A. Pulsatilla_) of our downs, but there is also the white or yellow Alpine Anemone (_A. alpina_), which forms so marked a feature of the Alpine pastures in early summer.

arxiv-1401-0479.title: Rational curves on hyperkähler manifolds
arxiv-1401-0479.creator: Ekaterina Amerik
arxiv-1401-0479.description: Abstract Abstract Let M be an irreducible holomorphically symplectic manifold. We show that all faces of the Kähler cone of M are hyperplanes H_{i} orthogonal to certain homology classes, called monodromy birationally minimal (MBM) classes. Moreover, the Kähler cone is a connected component of a complement of the positive cone to the union of all H_{i} .

arxiv-2104-08780.title: Relative orbifold Pandharipande-Thomas theory and the degeneration formula
arxiv-2104-08780.creator: Yijie Lin
arxiv-2104-08780.description: Abstract . We construct relative moduli spaces of semistable pairs on a family of projective Deligne-Mumford stacks. We define moduli stacks of stable orbifold Pandharipande-Thomas pairs on stacks of expanded degenerations and pairs, and then show they are separated and proper Deligne-Mumford stacks of finite type.

arxiv-2203-16628.title: Physics-constrained Unsupervised Learning of Partial Differential Equations using Meshes
arxiv-2203-16628.creator: Mike Y. Michelis, Robert K. Katzschmann
arxiv-2203-16628.description: Abstract Enhancing neural networks with knowledge of physical equations has become an efficient way of solving various physics problems, from fluid flow to electromagnetism. Graph neural networks show promise in accurately representing irregularly meshed objects and learning their dynamics, but have so far required supervision through large datasets.

arxiv-2208-12582.title: Hamilton and Souplet-Zhang type estimations on semilinear parabolic system along geometric flow
arxiv-2208-12582.creator: Shyamal Kumar Hui, Shahroud Azami and Sujit Bhattacharyya
arxiv-2208-12582.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shyamal Kumar Hui, Shahroud Azami and Sujit Bhattacharyya. In this article we derive both Hamilton type and Souplet-Zhang type gradient estimations for a system of semilinear equations along a geometric flow on a weighted Riemannian manifold. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C21, 58J60, 58J35, 35B45 1.

arxiv-2211-14296.title: A System for Morphology-Task Generalization via Unified Representation and Behavior Distillation
arxiv-2211-14296.creator: Hiroki Furuta, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Shixiang Shane Gu
arxiv-2211-14296.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hiroki Furuta, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Shixiang Shane Gu. The rise of generalist large-scale models in natural language and vision has made us expect that a massive data-driven approach could achieve broader generalization in other domains such as continuous control. In this work, we explore a method for learning a single policy that manipulates various forms of agents to solve various tasks by distilling a large amount of proficient behavioral data.

arxiv-2405-12093.title: Quantum dissipation at conical intersections of quasienergies
arxiv-2405-12093.creator: Sigmund Kohler
arxiv-2405-12093.description: Abstract We investigate the properties of Floquet states in the vicinity of a conical intersection of quasienergies and work out the consequences of the underlying spatio-temporal symmetries for a driven two-level system coupled to an ohmic heat bath. We find that on manifolds with constant quasienergy splitting, the mean energies of the Floquet states are continuously interchanged.

arxiv-2410-08849.title: Causal inference targeting a concentration index for studies of health inequalities
arxiv-2410-08849.creator: Mohammad Ghasempour
arxiv-2410-08849.description: Abstract A concentration index, a standardized covariance between a health variable and relative income ranks, is often used to quantify income-related health inequalities. There is a lack of formal approach to study the effect of an exposure, e.g., education, on such measures of inequality. In this paper we contribute by filling this gap and developing the necessary theory and method.

pmc-10532127.title: Retrospective Analysis of Bone Substitute Material for Traumatic Long Bone Fractures: Sex-Specific Outcomes
pmc-10532127.creator: Jonas Pawelke, Vithusha Vinayahalingam, Christian Heiss, Thaqif El Khassawna, Gero Knapp, Giuseppe Filardo, Manuela Salerno, Francesca Taraballi
pmc-10532127.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Male patients often experience increased bone and muscle loss after traumatic fractures. This study aims to compare the treatment outcomes of male and female patients with large bone defects. A total of 345 trauma patients underwent surgery, with participants divided into two groups: one receiving bone substitute material (BSM) for augmented defects (n = 192) and the other without augmentation (empty defects = ED, n = 153). Outcome parameters were assessed among female (n = 184) and male (n = 161) patients.

pmc-11493461.title: CCL20 chemokine and other proinflammatory markers after Ad26.COV2.S vaccination
pmc-11493461.creator: Iva Ivanko, Milena Hanžek, Ivana Ćelap, Sandra Margetić, Domagoj Marijančević, Josipa Josipović, Petar Gaćina
pmc-11493461.description: Graphical abstract Keywords: chemokine, vaccine, immunity Introduction Chemotactic cytokines (chemokines) are signaling molecules whose primary function is the recruitment of leukocytes and other inflammatory cells from the intravascular space, across the epithelium and endothelium to the specific sites within tissues during various inflammatory conditions (1).

pmc-11676347.title: Immortalization of Mesenchymal Stem Cells for Application in Regenerative Medicine and Their Potential Risks of Tumorigenesis
pmc-11676347.creator: Natsuki Yamaguchi, Eri Horio, Jukito Sonoda, Miu Yamagishi, Satomi Miyakawa, Fumihiro Murakami, Hideaki Hasegawa, Yasuhiro Katahira, Izuru Mizoguchi, Yasuyuki Fujii, Daichi Chikazu, Takayuki Yoshimoto, Sang-Bae Han
pmc-11676347.description: Regenerative medicine utilizes stem cells to repair damaged tissues by replacing them with their differentiated cells and activating the body’s inherent regenerative abilities. Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) are adult stem cells that possess tissue repair and regenerative capabilities and immunomodulatory properties with a much lower risk of tumorigenicity, making them a focus of numerous clinical trials worldwide.

pmc-12529455.title: Secular Trends in the Use of Valproate‐Containing Medicines in Women of Childbearing Age in Europe: A Multinational DARWIN EU Network Study
pmc-12529455.creator: Lucía Bellas, Martí Català, Edward Burn, Yuchen Guo, Mike Du, Katia Verhamme, Egil Fridgeirsson, Talita Duarte‐Salles, Tommi Kauko, Eeva Kronqvist, James T. Brash, Sarah Seager, Daniel Prieto‐Alhambra, Annika M. Jödicke, Albert Prats‐Uribe
pmc-12529455.description: BackgroundValproate‐containing medicines (VPA) are first‐line treatments for epilepsy; however, they pose teratogenic risks, restricting their use in women of childbearing age. We aimed to estimate the secular trends in the use of VPA and alternative treatments in young women, and to characterise dose/strength, treatment duration, and indication in new VPA users.

pmc-12565460.title: Opportunities and Risks of Promoting Skin and Bone Healing via Implant Biofunctionalization of Extracellular Matrix Protein ECM1
pmc-12565460.creator: Niklas R Braun, Andreas K Nüssler, Sabrina Ehnert, Lidy Fratila-Apachitei
pmc-12565460.description: Impaired bone regeneration and wound healing represent a major clinical and socioeconomic challenge for our aging and multimorbid population. Fracture and wound healing share many common features, with transforming growth factor beta (TGF-β) being a key regulator of inflammation, angiogenesis, fibroblast activation, and matrix remodeling.

pmc-13212912.title: Clinical setting-dependent diagnostic accuracy of artificial intelligence and store-and-forward diabetic retinopathy screening: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13212912.creator: Kai-Yang Chen, Hoi-Chun Chan, Chi-Ming Chan
pmc-13212912.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Population-based diabetic retinopathy (DR) screening requires diagnostic strategies that optimize clinical utility by balancing missed disease against referral burden. We performed a Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses of Diagnostic Test Accuracy studies (PRISMA-DTA)-guided systematic review and meta-analysis comparing autonomous artificial intelligence (AI) screening with store-and-forward (SAF) or conventional image-based teleophthalmology pathways, using manual, expert, or reading-center grading as the reference standard, across any DR, referable DR (RDR), vision-threatening DR (VTDR), and diabetic macular edema (DME).

pmc-13239036.title: Airway Management With a GlideScope® Spectrum LoPro Blade in a Child With Giant Facial Rhabdomyosarcoma: A Case Report
pmc-13239036.creator: Morio Kosokabe, Satoshi Sunaga, Ayano Sekigawa, Yukitoshi Niiyama
pmc-13239036.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Difficult airways can cause severe hypoxia when inducing general anesthesia unless they are well managed, especially for pediatric patients. Successful management of pediatric difficult airways requires meticulous assessments and preparations. The GlideScope® Spectrum LoPro is a thin, hyperangulated blade. Although its utility has been demonstrated in previous studies on Pierre Robin manikins or patients with severely restricted mouth openings, as yet there have been no case reports on its efficacy for children with difficult airways.

pmc-13471038.title: An Embedded Model of Care to Address Depression in the In‐Home Aged Care Setting
pmc-13471038.creator: Tanya E. Davison, Marissa Dickins, Julie Kelly, Sunil Bhar, Karen Smith
pmc-13471038.description: ObjectiveDepression is increasingly common among older Australians receiving home care, yet symptoms are often under‐recognised and access to evidence‐based psychological treatment remains limited. This paper introduces EMBED, a new model of care designed to improve detection, escalation and management of depression within routine home care service delivery.

pmc-13491779.title: Patients’ experiences of promoting and hindering factors in daily physical activity with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: a qualitative systematic review
pmc-13491779.creator: Yongjia Zhang, Ying Xu, Yan Yang, Jingyou Sun
pmc-13491779.description: Background and ObjectivesPhysical activity (PA) is essential for maintaining function and quality of life in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Yet, many return to sedentary behaviors after pulmonary rehabilitation. Identifying facilitators and barriers to daily activity is crucial for developing patient-centered interventions. However, qualitative evidence on patients’ experiences and perceptions remains limited.

pmc-13573310.title: Phylogeny of coccidian parasites (Eimeriorina, Apicomplexa) infecting shrews
pmc-13573310.creator: Anna Mácová, Roman Hrdlička, Jana Kvičerová, Jana Jass
pmc-13573310.description: Despite their ecological importance and protected status, the diversity, host associations, and evolutionary relationships of coccidia infecting shrews (Eulipotyphla: Soricidae) remain poorly understood. In particular, the extent of host specificity, the occurrence of host-switching events, and the relationships among coccidian lineages infecting different shrew hosts remain unclear.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definition.— In this section, the term “Federal Government” includes wholly owned Government corporations, and officers and employees of the Government or its executive departments, independent establishments, and agencies while acting in their official capacity. (b) Authority To Make Agreement.— The.
